messages:
maria_cs: FYI - Fenwick PM pinged about onboarding 'SmartForm' v1.2. Use-case: claim form ingestion -> PHI-aware summarization + discrete entity extraction. They want a 2-week pilot on Dedicated, KMS/HSM for keys, and SLA-like latency targets (p50 ~200ms, p95 <500ms) for short forms. Renewal is flagged if pilot stalls. Who can run preflight?
aj_dev: I can own infra setup. Need to know whether they need VPC/private control plane or dedicated in our cloud. Also: expected throughput? concurrent rps?
maria_cs: They expect ~20rps peak during biz hours, avg 5rps. Dedicated in our cloud is fine, but KMS + connectors required. They've sent a support ticket with samples (s3://fenwick/smartform/samples) and want a labeled subset for eval.
leo_ml: I'll handle eval plan. Deliverables: 1) labeled 500-doc test set, 2) safety checklist (PHI redaction, leak tests), 3) quality thresholds (>=98% extraction for claimant_name/dob/claim_amount), 4) latency bench. Quick question: do we have labeled data transfer SOP for PHI?
emily_enable: Yes, add me for onboarding runbook. I'll prep a preflight checklist and a customer-facing acceptance criteria doc. Proposed call: Tue 11am PT with Fenwick + SRE + CSM.
sam_ops: We can standby a 2xA100 pool for 2 weeks. Need internal reservation + billing approval. @deploy-bot create reservation ticket and attach cost estimate.
deploy-bot: Ticket INF-9011 created: "fenwick-smartform-pilot-reservation" (2w, 2xA100). ETA for provision after billing sign-off: 24h.
billing: Noted. Cost estimate ~$11.8k for 2 weeks. Please attach PO or billing sync.
maria_cs: I'll push PO this afternoon. Reminder: mark account health = YELLOW now; escalate to RED if pilot doesn't start within 5 business days.
leo_ml: Eval plan sketch: start with quantized 13B for latency; collect metrics vs 70B baseline for quality. Tests: PHI-tokenization (ensure SSNs masked), named-entity recall/precision, hallucination probes, prompt-injection fuzzing.
aj_dev: Rolling policy suggestion (simple JSON for ops):
```
{"route":"/smartform","variants":[{"name":"13b-quant","pct":10},{"name":"13b-quant-stable","pct":90}],"metrics":{"rollback_on":{"error_pct":1.5,"latency_p95_ms":700}}}
```
We'll wire up KV cache and prefix caching for repeated claim patterns.
safety-bot: Add automated privacy leakage suite to pipeline. Run NER-leak test, token overlap analysis, and synthetic PI inference attacks. Flag any PHI tokens emitted in plain.
emily_enable: Preflight checklist (to share with Fenwick):
- Signed DPA + PO
- Labeled 500-doc subset uploaded to s3 path with access grant
- KMS contact + VPN details
- Acceptance criteria doc (quality & latency thresholds)
- Rollback & incident contacts
I'll post doc after call invite.
csm_lead: Marking renewal risk as HIGH until pilot completes. We should schedule weekly check-ins during the pilot and capture feedback in Gainsight. Also prepare enablement session for their integration engineers.
maria_cs: I'll schedule weekly 30m syncs. Also sending the support ticket link and internal PO once filed. :thumbsup:
leo_ml: Once we get labeled subset, I'll run initial bench within 48-72h, run safety checks, then a small A/B with 70B for quality delta. Report will include precision/recall for each entity, PHI leakage count, and latency percentiles.
aj_dev: Noted. I'll create a canary route and CI job to run bench harness on deploy. Sample command for ops: `./bench --target=https://int.example/smartform --concurrency=10 --payload=sample.json`
sam_ops: Reserving capacity on hold until INF-9011 moves to approved state. Ops will not spin up without billing signoff.
maria_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll post updates and attach ticket/PO links here. If pilot stalls we notify exec sponsor.
